Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL376359 to include the parent and all salts. Join compound_records on molregno, then activities on record_id, then docs on doc_id, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Filter for target CHEMBL284 and standard_type IC50 with units nM. Left join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Do not deduplicate rows. Do not limit results.
